quotes.text: Then, as we progress along the covenant path, our relationship with God deepens, and our capacity for a joyful life expands. quotes.text: In other words, when we join the Church of Jesus Christ, we sayâhumbly, gratefully, and with quiet confidenceâthat we want to follow our beloved Savior, Jesus Christ. And we want to walk that path together.

quotes.text: But the Savior of the world, the Son of God, transcended worldly boundaries and divisions. As Paul said, He â[broke] down the middle wall of partition between us.â He consistently reached out to those who would otherwise be shunned as outsiders. He touched lepers. He praised Gentiles for their faith. He used a Samaritan as an example of compassion. He gathered people from different walks of life and asked them to serve together in positions of trust. He ministered to the poor and rich alike. And today He continues to invite all to come unto Him.

quotes.text: And yet the Saviorâs work of gathering continues, undaunted. In fact, it is accelerating. And as covenant followers of Jesus Christ, we recognize that we are all brothers and sisters, joyfully participating with Christ in gathering and uniting the great family of God.

quotes.text: In the Saviorâs Church, it is not our political views, culture, or personal interests that unite us. It is our love for God and neighbor, Godâs children. It is our commitment to our covenants with Jesus Christ and to His restored gospel. We are âone in Christ.â

quotes.text: Jesus Christ has the power to change usâyou and meâpurify us, and unite us. The closer we come to Him, the closer we will come to each otherâand the closer we will come to the unity He wants for us.
